home.description: I build the part of the product people actually touch, and enough of what's behind it to ship without waiting on anyone. I use AI every day. The judgment is still mine.

content.bio: I'm a frontend engineer in Buenos Aires. Since July 2026 I work at Reclee, a B2B SaaS that helps companies recruit faster. I own the frontend there: I set up the design system on shadcn/ui and ReUI, rebuilt the layouts mobile-first, organized the code by feature so business logic stays out of the components, and built the landing you see at reclee.com. Before that I spent a year at Pawtrics Software building a practice management system for veterinary clinics, fullstack with Next.js, Supabase and PostgreSQL.
content.details: I work T-shaped: deep on frontend, and I keep backend and infrastructure current enough to ship the whole thing. I use AI every day and I integrate it into products: this site runs on a NestJS CMS I wrote from scratch, with Postgres, an admin panel and an assistant on Gemini with vector search. What I enjoy most is building components. I maintain NachUI, an open source component system with its own CLI and registry, and right now I'm adding AI Elements to it, the pieces a chat interface needs: messages, streaming, tool calls. I study Programming at UTN and work on Fedora.

items.question: Who is Ignacio Figueroa?
items.answer: I'm Ignacio Figueroa, a frontend engineer from Buenos Aires, Argentina. Since July 2026 I work at Reclee, a B2B SaaS that helps companies recruit faster, where I own the frontend and the design system. Before that I spent a year at Pawtrics Software building a practice management system for veterinary clinics. I'm also the author of NachUI, an open source component system.

items.question: Is Ignacio Figueroa a frontend or a fullstack developer?
items.answer: Frontend engineer, T-shaped. My depth is in React, Next.js and design systems, and I keep backend and infrastructure current enough to ship a product end to end: this site runs on a NestJS API and PostgreSQL that I wrote myself, deployed on Vercel and Supabase.

items.question: What does Ignacio Figueroa do at Reclee?
items.answer: At Reclee I set up the design system on shadcn/ui and ReUI, rebuilt the application layouts mobile-first, organized the frontend by feature so business logic stays out of the components, and built the public landing at reclee.com. I ship tickets from Linear through GitHub code reviews.

items.question: What tech stack does Ignacio Figueroa use?
items.answer: Day to day I write TypeScript with React, Next.js and Tailwind CSS. On the backend I use NestJS with PostgreSQL, Drizzle and Supabase, and Python with FastAPI when a project calls for it. For AI work I use Google Gemini through the Vercel AI SDK, with pgvector for retrieval. I develop on Fedora Linux and use AI agents like Claude Code every day.

items.question: What is NachUI?
items.answer: NachUI is the open source component system I build, published at nachui.tech. It ships accessible React primitives that you copy into your project as source code instead of installing as a dependency. The monorepo also holds a CLI that injects components and OKLCH design tokens, a NestJS registry API, and an AI agent that answers questions from the real source code. Right now I'm adding AI Elements: the pieces a chat interface needs, like messages, streaming and tool calls.

items.question: Is Ignacio Figueroa available for work?
items.answer: Yes. I'm open to frontend and AI integration roles on product teams, on contract or full-time, working remotely from Buenos Aires. The fastest way to reach me is contact@ignaciofigueroa.dev, and the contact form on this site sends me a direct email.

items.question: Where does Ignacio Figueroa live and what timezone is he in?
items.answer: I live in Buenos Aires, Argentina, in the UTC−3 timezone. That overlaps with most of the United States business day and with European mornings, and I work remotely.

items.question: What languages does Ignacio Figueroa work in?
items.answer: Spanish is my first language and I work professionally in English. The documentation, code, and commit messages I write are in English, and this site is published in both languages. You're reading the English version.

items.question: What has Ignacio Figueroa built with AI?
items.answer: The assistant on this site: a NestJS service on Google Gemini and the Vercel AI SDK that answers questions about my work with vector search over my own content, calls tools to show projects and experience, and can analyze a job description against my profile. I also built NachUI Support AI, a tool-calling agent that reads the real NachUI source code at query time, and Services AI Assistant, a Gemini agent that collects contact requests through function calling.

items.question: What did Ignacio Figueroa study?
items.answer: I'm studying for an Associate Degree in Programming and Software Development at Universidad Tecnológica Nacional in Argentina, which I started in March 2025. I've been learning software development on my own since March 2022, and I hold certifications from Anthropic (Claude 101) and Google.
